This '''cantina''' was located in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
This [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] contained a central bar, two special rooms where guests could be alone as well as multiple [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancers and a [[Band/Legends|band]] composed of three [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] and an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]].

Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] came to this cantina to talk to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] about an assassination attempt on [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
